newsitem.title: USA: Conn. Development Authority 6.20 pct yld in 2036.
newsitem.headline: Conn. Development Authority 6.20 pct yld in 2036.

text.p: Advest Inc said Wednesday it priced a $30 million Connecticut Development Authority water facilities revenue bond issue, Series 1996 A, for the Bridgeport Hydrolic Co project.
The bullet maturity was priced with a six percent coupon to yield 6.20 percent in 2036.
The bonds are dated 10/3/1996 and due 9/1/2036. The first coupon is 3/1/1997.
The bonds are rated A-plus by Standard & poor's Corp.
The bonds are callable 9/1/2006 at 102.00, declining to par 9/1/2008.
